source: Pinned ATen scalar implementation; reusable parameterized contiguous FP32 reference
adaptation: ATen addcdiv_cpu_kernel float scalar lambda. TensorIterator iteration becomes a C loop; scalar_t is float; scalar_t(0) is 0.0f; scalar parameters and operation order retained. Library API implementation is proprietary: the backend graph is mechanically emitted from this reference and its opcode semantics are separately trusted and tested.

specs.name: aten_addcdiv_f32
assumptions: contiguous FP32 arrays; output disjoint from inputs
errno and floating exception flags are not observed
